notes: Page lists related brands (AirEase, Airease-Johnson, Aire-flo, Allied-Commercial, Allied, Armstrong Air, Concord, Ducane, Magic-Pak, Advanced Distributor Products (ADP), Heatcraft) but does not document that any shares this serial system, so no sisters or usesStylesOf are set. Page presents pre-1973 serials as a single style with a 1- or 2-digit month; split here into two file styles because schema positions are fixed ranges. Two-digit years resolve by the schema century rule with the default 1960 floor, so pre-1960 pre-1973 serials return cannot-determine rather than a guessed year. The page documents only one month-letter system (A-M minus I, 1973+); there are no separate month-letter eras to encode.
